'''Ruusan 2''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]], located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Ruusan system/Legends|Ruusan system]]. It was one of the [[Three Sisters]]. A [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Skytop Station/Legends|listening post]] was positioned there during the Clone Wars.

==Characteristics==
[[File:Ruusan_moon_1.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The [[Vulture's Claw/Legends|''Vulture's Claw'']] flies through the moon's atmosphere toward Skytop Station.]]
The moon had a very turbulent atmosphere with frequent storms. Lightning and giant clouds constantly raged over the surface.<ref name="The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''</ref>

==History==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] built the [[Skytop Station/Legends|Skytop Station]] and positioned it in the atmosphere of the Ruusan moon. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] [[Raid on Skytop Station/Legends|infiltrated]] the station on a mission to retrieve the stolen [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. The station was eventually destroyed after they had completed their mission.

==Behind the scenes==
Although not mentioned individually, Ruusan 2 is one of "the triplets" seen and mentioned in the novels ''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]'' and ''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]'', written several years before ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' series.

Also according to the latter, some "ruins" are tentatively mentioned to be on one of the moons, but not specifying which. The sources haven't identified that moon with Ruusan 2, or whether the ruins belonged to the Skytop Station.
